description.p: whatRust is an unofficial, independent desktop client that loads the official WhatsApp Web interface in the system WebKitGTK webview. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by WhatsApp or Meta.
It adds desktop features beyond a browser tab:

ul.li: Multiple isolated WhatsApp accounts in separate windows
Native notifications, system tray integration, and close to tray
Drag-and-drop attachment routing with bounded memory use
Optional password lock and automatic idle locking
Persistent sessions, display scaling, and configurable shortcuts

description.p: Voice messages work on Linux. Voice and video calls normally do not because mainstream Linux WebKitGTK runtimes are built without compatible WebRTC support.

screenshot.caption: Manage accounts, desktop preferences, shortcuts, and app lock

description.p: Fixes the AppImage failing to load WhatsApp behind an HTTP(S) proxy, and a startup error in the page on Linux and macOS.
Makes message notifications appear on Windows, with a fallback alert on every platform when a new chat goes unread without one.
Fixes notifications and the unread badge, opens links from chats, handles whatsapp:// links, and adds download feedback with a refreshed settings layout.
Adds native Flatpak packaging and sandbox-aware single-instance and autostart integration.
Improves drag-and-drop ordering, responsiveness, decoding, and memory bounds.
Adds responsive large-file drag and drop across desktop platforms.
